must_identify.item: The api cannot reach redis (connection timeouts), which is why /api/ returns 5xx; redis itself is healthy
The cause is the NetworkPolicy redis, which allows ingress to redis only from app=worker, not from the api

notes: The RCA says only 'No problems detected' and no commands were recorded, so the investigator may never have run. A reviewer could reasonably grade this 'wrong' instead, since it denies a problem that a critical alert shows; check whether the agent failed to execute.
